description: This Java interface defines methods for managing content in a content management system, including adding, removing, retrieving, and listing content and content files for merchant stores.

classes.name: ContentService
classes.description: Interface for content management operations related to merchant stores, including CRUD operations and file handling.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists content by type for a specific merchant store and language.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists content by multiple types for a specific merchant store and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves content by code for a merchant store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves content by code, store, and language.

methods.name: addContentFile
methods.description: Stores a content file for a merchant store.

methods.name: addContentFiles
methods.description: Stores multiple content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific content file by name and type.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFile
methods.description: Fetches a specific content file for a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFiles
methods.description: Retrieves all content files of a specific type for a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFilesNames
methods.description: Gets names of content files for a merchant store and content type.

methods.name: addLogo
methods.description: Adds a logo for a merchant store.

methods.name: addOptionImage
methods.description: Adds an option image for a merchant store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists content by type for a merchant store.

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: Lists content descriptions by type for a merchant store and language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves content by ID and language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves content description by store and URL.
